title: add-mini-batch-template-generator-and-quant-swatch-orchestrator
author: Asha Nambiar
description: Motivation: reduce time-to-value for cost-safe batching/quantization rollouts by providing opinionated mini-batch templates and a lightweight quantization swatch orchestrator that can be auto-provisioned per workload. This PR introduces a template generator (CLI + backend hooks), a set of curated quantization swatch profiles, and runtime guards + telemetry to evaluate unit economics during canary rollouts. Key goals: 1) make it easy for platform and product teams to try conservative batching/quant profiles without manual tuning, 2) capture unit-econ signals (tokens per USD, p95 latency, quality deltas) during short canaries, and 3) provide safe fallbacks and gradual ramp policies if quality regressions are detected. What changed: new CLI command rwectl econ template generate, a mini-batcher runtime component with three starter templates (conservative, balanced, aggressive), a quantization swatch YAML catalog and merge logic, telemetry events and eval hooks tied to prompt-sets, a short e2e sim harness to sanity-check throughput/latency, and updated console UI to visualize unit-econ deltas. Rollout plan: feature toggled behind econ.templates gate, staged canary to customers with opt-in, metrics-driven rollout using existing rollout controller. Related Linear: ENG-3245 (template generator), ENG-3401 (quant swatch orchestration).

release_notes: Added: rwectl econ template generate CLI, three starter mini-batching templates (conservative/balanced/aggressive), quantization swatch catalog and orchestrator, unit-econ telemetry events, console econ-wizard UI. Behavior: feature gated behind econ.templates; safe rollout with automatic rollback on quality regression. Impact: reduces time to test cost-optimized batching/quant profiles at scale.
testing_notes: Local simulation harness covers throughput/latency/quality delta metrics across three templates; added a long-sequence scenario. Recommend running e2e-sim under representative workload and verifying unit_econ_v2 metrics before enabling gate in a prod cluster.
notes_for_oncall: If customers report quality regressions after enabling templates, flip econ.templates=false to disable generator-driven rollouts and trigger rollback via rollout controller. Telemetry uses unit_econ_v2 namespace; look for signals: unit_econ_v2.quality_regression, unit_econ_v2.tokens_per_us, unit_econ_v2.p95_ms.
security_review: no secrets introduced. quant swatch YAMLs are static profiles. KMS/HSM and data plane unaffected.
migration_instructions: No DB schema changes. To adopt templates, operators can install helm/values-econ-templates.yaml and opt-in via feature flag. Existing custom batcher configs remain unchanged unless explicitly migrated via rwectl export/import.
